1→# DuckDB Data Agent
     2→
     3→> **Note:** This project is built with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/product/claude-code)(using Opus 4.6 and [superpowers](https://github.com/obra/superpowers)) by more than 95% and human-reviewed by author.
     4→
     5→[![Deploy to Render](https://render.com/images/deploy-to-render-button.svg)](https://render.com/deploy)
     6→
     7→An AI-powered data analysis agent with a built-in SQL playground. Upload data files (CSV, JSON, Parquet, Excel) and ask questions in plain English, or switch to the SQL editor for direct queries — powered by [DuckDB](https://duckdb.org/) on a lightweight [FastAPI](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/) backend with a React frontend. The app opens in Agent Mode by default so you can start analyzing data immediately.
     8→
     9→Each browser tab gets its own isolated, in-memory DuckDB session — uploaded data and query state are fully isolated between users and tabs, with idle sessions automatically cleaned up after 5 minutes of inactivity.
    10→
    11→## Features
    12→
    13→### General
    14→
    15→- **Per-user DuckDB sessions** — Each browser tab gets its own isolated in-memory DuckDB instance, identified by a `X-Session-ID` header generated client-side; data and state are never shared between users or tabs; idle sessions are automatically cleaned up after 5 minutes
    16→- **DuckDB SQL engine** — Fast, in-process analytical database on the backend
    17→- **Multi-format file upload** — Drag-and-drop or click to import CSV, JSON, Parquet, and Excel (.xlsx) files (default limit: 500 MB, configurable via `MAX_TOTAL_SIZE_BYTES` env var) with automatic schema detection; Excel workbooks with multiple sheets create one table per sheet; duplicate filename detection prevents accidental overwrites; the upload UI appears when no tables are loaded, and files can also be added via the sidebar upload button
    18→- **Sample dataset** — One-click load of the Titanic dataset to get started quickly
    19→- **Table sidebar** — Collapsible panel to browse tables, inspect columns, and view types
    20→- **Dark / light mode** — Toggle between dark and light themes with the sun/moon button in the header; respects your OS preference on first visit and remembers your choice across sessions
    21→- **Internationalization (i18n)** — Switch between English and Traditional Chinese with the EN/中 toggle in the header; auto-detects your OS language on first visit and remembers your choice across sessions
    22→
    23→### Agent Mode (default mode)
    24→
    25→- **Natural language queries** — Ask questions about your data in plain English; the agent writes and executes SQL for you
    26→- **Streaming responses** — Real-time token streaming powered by Claude via the [Anthropic Agent SDK](https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python)
    27→- **Visible reasoning** — Collapsible thinking block shows the agent's intermediate steps and SQL queries
    28→- **Inline results** — Query results rendered inline within the conversation
    29→- **Edit & delete messages** — Hover over any user message to edit or delete it; editing re-sends the modified query with prior conversation as context, deleting rewinds the conversation to that point
    30→- **Credential proxy** — The backend runs a built-in Anthropic API reverse proxy; each agent session receives a short-lived UUID token instead of the real API key, so the Claude Code subprocess never has access to `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`; tokens are revoked immediately when the session ends (see [Security](#security))
    31→- **Privacy-conscious** — Requires an Anthropic API key stored in a server-side `.env` file; your data and credentials are never sent anywhere besides the Anthropic API
    32→- **Langfuse observability** (optional) — Built-in [Langfuse](https://langfuse.com/) tracing for monitoring agent interactions, with a one-click dashboard link in the UI
    33→
    34→### Editor Mode
    35→
    36→- **SQL query editor** — Write and execute queries with Ctrl/Cmd+Enter
    37→- **Interactive results** — Sortable columns, per-column filters, and global search across results
    38→- **EXPLAIN support** — Markdown-rendered output for `EXPLAIN` and `EXPLAIN ANALYZE` queries
    39→
    40→## Getting Started
    41→
    42→### Prerequisites
    43→
    44→- [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/) 20+
    45→- [Python](https://www.python.org/) 3.12+
    46→- [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/)
    47→
    48→### Installation
    49→
    50→```bash
    51→make install
    52→```
    53→
    54→Or install frontend and backend separately:
    55→
    56→```bash
    57→cd frontend && npm install
    58→cd backend && poetry install
    59→```
    60→
    61→### Configuration
    62→
    63→Copy the example environment file and add your credentials:
    64→
    65→```bash
    66→cp backend/.env.example backend/.env
    67→```
    68→
    69→Edit `backend/.env` and set your Anthropic API key:
    70→
    71→```
    72→ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-...
    73→ANTHROPIC_MODEL=sonnet              # optional, defaults to sonnet
    74→MAX_TOTAL_SIZE_BYTES=524288000      # optional, max upload size in bytes (default: 500 MB)
    75→```
    76→
    77→> `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` and `ANTHROPIC_MODEL` are only needed for the AI agent. The SQL playground works without them, but both require the backend running.
    78→
    79→#### Langfuse (optional)
    80→
    81→To enable agent tracing with [Langfuse](https://langfuse.com/), add these to `backend/.env`:
    82→
    83→```
    84→LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY=pk-lf-...
    85→LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY=sk-lf-...
    86→LANGFUSE_BASE_URL=https://cloud.langfuse.com   # optional, defaults to cloud
    87→```
    88→
    89→When configured, every agent conversation is traced (LLM turns, tool calls, SQL execution) and a **Langfuse Traces** button appears in the agent panel header linking to your dashboard. When not configured, tracing is disabled with zero overhead.
    90→
    91→### Development
    92→
    93→Start both the frontend and backend:
    94→
    95→```bash
    96→make dev
    97→```
    98→
    99→Or run them separately:
   100→
   101→```bash
   102→make frontend   # http://localhost:5173
   103→make backend    # http://localhost:8000
   104→```
   105→
   106→Open http://localhost:5173 to use the app. The Vite dev server proxies `/api` requests to the backend automatically.
   107→
   108→## Production Build and Deployment
   109→
   110→The project ships as a single Docker image that bundles the React frontend and FastAPI backend. A multi-stage `Dockerfile` builds the frontend, then copies the output into the backend's static directory.
   111→
   112→### Build and run locally
   113→
   114→```bash
   115→docker build -t duckdb-data-agent .
   116→
   117→docker run -p 10000:10000 \
   118→  -e ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-... \
   119→  duckdb-data-agent
   120→```
   121→
   122→Add `-e LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY=pk-lf-... -e LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY=sk-lf-...` to either command to enable Langfuse tracing.
   123→
   124→Open http://localhost:10000 to use the app.
   125→
   126→### Deploy to Render
   127→
   128→A `render.yaml` is included for one-click deployment on [Render](https://render.com/):
   129→
   130→1. Push this repo to GitHub.
   131→2. In Render, create a new **Blueprint** and connect the repo.
   132→3. Set `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` in the Render dashboard. Optionally set `ANTHROPIC_MODEL` to override the default model (`sonnet`). To enable Langfuse tracing, also set `LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY` and `LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY`.
   133→
   134→Render will build the Docker image and deploy it automatically on every push to `main`.
   135→
   136→## Security
   137→
   138→### Credential Proxy
   139→
   140→When the agent runs, the backend spawns a Claude Code subprocess via the Anthropic Agent SDK. A naive approach would pass `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` directly into that subprocess's environment — but any tool or shell command the agent executes could then read and exfiltrate the key.
   141→
   142→Instead, the backend runs a built-in reverse proxy at `/anthropic` that sits between Claude Code and `api.anthropic.com`:
   143→
   144→```
   145→Claude Code subprocess
   146→  → ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:{PORT}/anthropic
   147→  → ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=<short-lived UUID token>
   148→        ↓
   149→FastAPI proxy (/anthropic/{path})
   150→  → validates UUID token
   151→  → swaps it for the real ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
   152→  → forwards request to api.anthropic.com
   153→```
   154→
   155→**How it works:**
   156→
   157→1. Before each agent session, the backend mints a random UUID token with a 10-minute TTL.
   158→2. The token is injected into the subprocess environment as `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`; the real key is never exposed.
   159→3. The proxy validates every inbound request against the token store and substitutes the real key before forwarding upstream.
   160→4. When the session ends, the token is explicitly revoked in a `finally` block, regardless of success or error.
   161→5. A background task runs every 60 seconds to sweep any tokens that outlived their TTL.
   162→
   163→The subprocess only ever holds a single-session UUID. Even if a tool call reads the environment, all it gets is a temporary token scoped to that conversation.
   164→
   165→## Project Structure
   166→
   167→```
   168→├── frontend/               # React frontend
   169→│   ├── src/
   170→│   │   ├── components/     #   UI components (editor, results, sidebar, chat)
   171→│   │   ├── contexts/       #   React context providers (theme, language, agent, config, session)
   172→│   │   ├── hooks/          #   Custom hooks (useTheme, useTranslation, useAgent, useConfig)
   173→│   │   ├── agent/          #   Agent service (SSE event handling, session ID injection)
   174→│   │   ├── i18n/           #   Translation files (en.json, zh-TW.json)
   175→│   │   └── types.ts        #   Shared TypeScript interfaces
   176→│   ├── index.html          #   HTML entry point
   177→│   ├── package.json        #   npm config
   178→│   └── vite.config.ts      #   Vite bundler config
   179→├── backend/                # FastAPI backend
   180→│   └── app/
   181→│       ├── main.py         #   App setup, CORS, and background session cleanup loop
   182→│       ├── config.py       #   Environment variables (API key, model, upload limits)
   183→│       ├── database.py     #   DuckDB connection, query execution, and per-user SessionManager
   184→│       ├── agent.py        #   Agent loop & SSE streaming
   185→│       ├── proxy.py        #   Credential proxy: token store + /anthropic reverse proxy
   186→│       ├── tracing.py      #   Langfuse client wrapper & initialization
   187→│       ├── tools.py        #   Agent SDK tool definitions (execute_sql)
   188→│       ├── data/           #   Sample datasets (titanic.csv)
   189→│       └── routes/         #   API endpoints (tables, query, chat, config, langfuse status, heartbeat)
   190→├── Dockerfile              # Multi-stage production build
   191→├── render.yaml             # Render deployment config
   192→└── Makefile                # Dev commands (install, dev, clean)
   193→```
   194→
   195→## Tech Stack
   196→
   197→**Frontend**
   198→- [React](https://react.dev/) 18 + [TypeScript](https://www.typescriptlang.org/)
   199→- [Vite](https://vite.dev/)
   200→
   201→**Backend**
   202→- [FastAPI](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/) + [Uvicorn](https://www.uvicorn.org/)
   203→- [DuckDB](https://duckdb.org/) (Python)
   204→- [Anthropic Agent SDK](https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python)
   205→- [Langfuse](https://langfuse.com/) (optional, for observability)
   206→

1→import logging
     2→import uuid
     3→from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
     4→
     5→from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Request
     6→from fastapi.responses import StreamingResponse
     7→import httpx
     8→
     9→from app.config import ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
    10→
    11→logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    12→
    13→ANTHROPIC_UPSTREAM = "https://api.anthropic.com"
    14→
    15→_SKIP_REQUEST_HEADERS = {
    16→    "host", "content-length", "transfer-encoding", "connection",
    17→    "x-api-key",         # client must not override billing identity
    18→    "anthropic-version", # proxy controls API version
    19→    # anthropic-beta is intentionally NOT blocked: Claude Code sends beta body
    20→    # fields (e.g. context_management) alongside the matching beta header, and
    21→    # Anthropic rejects those fields as "extra inputs" if the header is absent.
    22→}
    23→_SKIP_RESPONSE_HEADERS = {"transfer-encoding", "content-encoding", "connection"}
    24→
    25→
    26→class ProxyTokenStore:
    27→    def __init__(self, ttl_seconds: int = 600):
    28→        self._ttl = ttl_seconds
    29→        self._tokens: dict[str, datetime] = {}
    30→
    31→    def create_token(self) -> str:
    32→        token = str(uuid.uuid4())
    33→        self._tokens[token] = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(seconds=self._ttl)
    34→        return token
    35→
    36→    def validate_token(self, token: str) -> bool:
    37→        # Tokens are intentionally multi-use: Claude Code makes many API calls
    38→        # per session, all protected by the same UUID. The token is valid for
    39→        # the session TTL (600s safety net) but is explicitly revoked by
    40→        # proxy_token_store.revoke_token() in agent.py's finally block when
    41→        # the Claude Code subprocess exits. Do not make single-use.
    42→        expiry = self._tokens.get(token)
    43→        if expiry is None:
    44→            return False
    45→        if datetime.now(timezone.utc) > expiry:
    46→            self._tokens.pop(token, None)
    47→            return False
    48→        return True
    49→
    50→    def revoke_token(self, token: str) -> None:
    51→        self._tokens.pop(token, None)
    52→
    53→    def cleanup_expired(self) -> int:
    54→        now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    55→        expired = [t for t, exp in self._tokens.items() if now > exp]
    56→        for t in expired:
    57→            del self._tokens[t]
    58→        return len(expired)
    59→
    60→
    61→proxy_token_store = ProxyTokenStore()
    62→
    63→router = APIRouter(prefix="/anthropic")
    64→
    65→
    66→@router.api_route("/{path:path}", methods=["GET", "POST", "PUT", "DELETE", "PATCH"])
    67→async def proxy_anthropic(path: str, request: Request):
    68→    # Claude Code CLI sends the API key as x-api-key (Anthropic SDK default).
    69→    # Fall back to Authorization: Bearer for other clients.
    70→    session_token = (
    71→        request.headers.get("x-api-key")
    72→        or request.headers.get("authorization", "")[len("Bearer "):]
    73→        or None
    74→    )
    75→    if not session_token or not proxy_token_store.validate_token(session_token):
    76→        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid or expired session token")
    77→
    78→    headers = {
    79→        k: v for k, v in request.headers.items()
    80→        if k.lower() not in _SKIP_REQUEST_HEADERS
    81→    }
    82→    headers["x-api-key"] = ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
    83→    headers["anthropic-version"] = "2023-06-01"
    84→
    85→    body = await request.body()
    86→
    87→    # Use a fresh client per request: streaming responses that are cut short
    88→    # (e.g. client disconnects) leave connections in a partial read state, and
    89→    # reusing a shared SSL context across those connections causes
    90→    # SSLV3_ALERT_BAD_RECORD_MAC / record layer failure errors.
    91→    # Query params are intentionally NOT forwarded — Claude Code appends
    92→    # internal params (e.g. ?beta=true) that Anthropic rejects as "extra inputs".
    93→    client = httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=httpx.Timeout(300.0))
    94→    try:
    95→        upstream_req = client.build_request(
    96→            method=request.method,
    97→            url=f"{ANTHROPIC_UPSTREAM}/{path}",
    98→            headers=headers,
    99→            content=body,
   100→        )
   101→        upstream_resp = await client.send(upstream_req, stream=True)
   102→
   103→        response_headers = {
   104→            k: v for k, v in upstream_resp.headers.items()
   105→            if k.lower() not in _SKIP_RESPONSE_HEADERS
   106→        }
   107→
   108→        async def body_generator():
   109→            try:
   110→                async for chunk in upstream_resp.aiter_bytes():
   111→                    yield chunk
   112→            finally:
   113→                await upstream_resp.aclose()
   114→                await client.aclose()
   115→
   116→        return StreamingResponse(
   117→            body_generator(),
   118→            status_code=upstream_resp.status_code,
   119→            headers=response_headers,
   120→        )
   121→    except Exception:
   122→        await client.aclose()
   123→        logger.exception("Proxy request to upstream failed: %s %s", request.method, path)
   124→        raise
   125→

     2→import logging
     3→from typing import AsyncIterator
     4→
     5→from claude_agent_sdk import (
     6→    ClaudeSDKClient,

    14→from claude_agent_sdk.types import StreamEvent, SystemMessage
    15→from claude_agent_sdk._errors import MessageParseError
    16→from app.tools import create_duckdb_server
    17→from app.database import Database
    18→from app.config import ANTHROPIC_MODEL, PROXY_BASE_URL
    19→from app.proxy import proxy_token_store
    20→from app.tracing import get_langfuse_client
    21→
    22→logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    23→
    24→# Monkey-patch parse_message to handle unknown message types (e.g. rate_limit_event)
    25→# gracefully instead of crashing the stream. The SDK (v0.1.39) doesn't recognize
    26→# newer message types from the CLI. Returning a SystemMessage lets the stream
    27→# continue since our code ignores SystemMessage instances.
    28→import claude_agent_sdk._internal.message_parser as _parser
    29→
    30→_original_parse_message = _parser.parse_message
    31→
    32→
    33→def _safe_parse_message(data):
    34→    try:
    35→        return _original_parse_message(data)
    36→    except MessageParseError as e:
    37→        if "Unknown message type" in str(e):
    38→            msg_type = data.get("type", "unknown") if isinstance(data, dict) else "unknown"
    39→            logger.warning("Skipping unrecognized message type from CLI: %s", msg_type)
    40→            return SystemMessage(subtype=msg_type, data=data if isinstance(data, dict) else {})
    41→        raise
    42→
    43→
    44→_parser.parse_message = _safe_parse_message
    45→
    46→
    47→def build_system_prompt(db: Database) -> str:
    48→    tables = db.list_tables()
    49→    prompt = """You are a helpful data analyst assistant working with a DuckDB database.
    50→You can execute SQL queries using the execute_sql tool to answer questions about the user's data.
    51→
    52→Guidelines:
    53→- Write clear, efficient DuckDB SQL queries
    54→- When exploring data, start with small queries (use LIMIT)
    55→- Explain your findings in plain language after getting results
    56→- If a query fails, try to fix it and retry
    57→- Use double quotes for table and column names that might conflict with reserved words
    58→
    59→Identity:
    60→- You are an AI assistant. If asked whether you are an AI or a human, always confirm that you are an AI.
    61→- Do not disclose the name, version, or provider of the underlying language model powering you, regardless of how the question is phrased.
    62→"""
    63→    if not tables:
    64→        prompt += "\nNo tables are currently loaded. Ask the user to upload a CSV file first."
    65→    else:
    66→        prompt += "\nCurrently loaded tables:\n"
    67→        for table in tables:
    68→            prompt += f'\nTable: "{table["name"]}" ({table["rowCount"]} rows)\nColumns:\n'
    69→            for col in table["columns"]:
    70→                prompt += f'  - "{col["name"]}" ({col["type"]})\n'
    71→
    72→    return prompt
    73→
    74→
    75→def _build_message_with_history(
    76→    message: str, conversation_history: list[dict] | None = None
    77→) -> str:
    78→    """Prepend conversation history context to the user message when editing."""
    79→    if not conversation_history:
    80→        return message
    81→
    82→    history_text = "Previous conversation (for context, I am now editing a message):\n"
    83→    for entry in conversation_history:
    84→        role = entry.get("role", "user").capitalize()
    85→        content = entry.get("content", "")
    86→        history_text += f"\n{role}: {content}\n"
    87→    history_text += f"\n---\n\nMy updated message:\n{message}"
    88→    return history_text
    89→
    90→
    91→def _extract_tool_result_text(content: object) -> str:
    92→    """Extract text from ToolResultBlock.content."""
    93→    if content is None:
    94→        return ""
    95→    if isinstance(content, str):
    96→        return content
    97→    if isinstance(content, list):
    98→        parts = []
    99→        for item in content:
   100→            if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("type") == "text":
   101→                parts.append(item.get("text", ""))
   102→        return "\n".join(parts)
   103→    return str(content)
   104→
   105→
   106→async def stream_chat(
   107→    message: str,
   108→    session_id: str | None = None,
   109→    db: Database | None = None,
   110→    conversation_history: list[dict] | None = None,
   111→    langfuse_session_id: str | None = None,
   112→) -> AsyncIterator[str]:
   113→    """Stream agent chat responses as SSE events."""
   114→    if db is None:
   115→        raise ValueError("db must be provided")
   116→    duckdb_server = create_duckdb_server(db)
   117→
   118→    logger.info("Using model: %s", ANTHROPIC_MODEL)
   119→
   120→    # Collect stderr from the CLI subprocess for debugging
   121→    stderr_lines: list[str] = []
   122→
   123→    # Use the --resume flag to continue an existing session
   124→    session_token = proxy_token_store.create_token()
   125→    options = ClaudeAgentOptions(
   126→        model=ANTHROPIC_MODEL,
   127→        system_prompt=build_system_prompt(db),
   128→        mcp_servers={"duckdb": duckdb_server},
   129→        allowed_tools=["mcp__duckdb__execute_sql"],
   130→        permission_mode="bypassPermissions",
   131→        max_turns=20,
   132→        include_partial_messages=True,
   133→        stderr=lambda line: stderr_lines.append(line),
   134→        env={
   135→            "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY": session_token,
   136→            "ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL": f"{PROXY_BASE_URL}/anthropic",
   137→        },
   138→        **({"resume": session_id} if session_id else {}),
   139→    )
   140→
   141→    # When editing, prepend conversation history to the user message
   142→    # instead of bloating the system prompt
   143→    query_message = _build_message_with_history(message, conversation_history)
   144→
   145→    client = ClaudeSDKClient(options=options)
   146→    # Will be set from the CLI's ResultMessage; use the passed-in value until then
   147→    actual_session_id = session_id
   148→
   149→    # --- Langfuse OTel tracing setup (conditional) ---
   150→    # Deferred: session_id is set after the CLI returns it in ResultMessage
   151→    langfuse = get_langfuse_client()
   152→    observation_ctx = None
   153→    propagate_ctx = None
   154→    if langfuse:
   155→        try:
   156→            trace_input: dict = {"message": message[:500]}
   157→            if conversation_history:
   158→                trace_input["conversation_history"] = conversation_history
   159→            observation_ctx = langfuse.start_as_current_observation(
   160→                name="agent-chat",
   161→                input=trace_input,
   162→                metadata={"model": ANTHROPIC_MODEL},
   163→            )
   164→            observation_ctx.__enter__()
   165→
   166→            # Propagate the stable conversation session_id for child spans
   167→            effective_langfuse_session_id = langfuse_session_id or session_id
   168→            if effective_langfuse_session_id:
   169→                from langfuse import propagate_attributes
   170→                propagate_ctx = propagate_attributes(session_id=effective_langfuse_session_id)
   171→                propagate_ctx.__enter__()
   172→        except Exception as e:
   173→            logger.debug("Failed to set up Langfuse tracing context: %s", e)
   174→            observation_ctx = None
   175→
   176→    try:
   177→        await client.connect()
   178→        await client.query(query_message, session_id=session_id or "default")
   179→
   180→        has_tool_calls = False
   181→        has_thinking = False
   182→        sql_result_ids: set[str] = set()
   183→        tool_names: dict[str, str] = {}
   184→
   185→        async for msg in client.receive_response():
   186→            if isinstance(msg, StreamEvent):
   187→                event = msg.event
   188→                event_type = event.get("type", "")
   189→
   190→                if event_type == "content_block_delta":
   191→                    delta = event.get("delta", {})
   192→                    delta_type = delta.get("type", "")
   193→                    if delta_type == "thinking_delta":
   194→                        text = delta.get("thinking", "")
   195→                        if text:
   196→                            yield f"event: thinking\ndata: {json.dumps({'text': text})}\n\n"
   197→                    elif delta_type == "text_delta":
   198→                        text = delta.get("text", "")
   199→                        event_name = "thinking" if not has_tool_calls else "answer"
   200→                        yield f"event: {event_name}\ndata: {json.dumps({'text': text})}\n\n"
   201→
   202→                elif event_type == "content_block_start":
   203→                    block = event.get("content_block", {})
   204→                    block_type = block.get("type")
   205→                    if block_type == "thinking":
   206→                        has_thinking = True
   207→                    elif block_type == "text":
   208→                        if has_thinking:
   209→                            yield f"event: thinking_done\ndata: {json.dumps({})}\n\n"
   210→                    elif block_type == "tool_use":
   211→                        has_thinking = False
   212→                        has_tool_calls = True
   213→
   214→            elif isinstance(msg, AssistantMessage):
   215→                for block in msg.content:
   216→                    if isinstance(block, ToolUseBlock):
   217→                        has_tool_calls = True
   218→                        tool_name = getattr(block, "name", "") or ""
   219→                        tool_names[block.id] = tool_name
   220→                        sql = block.input.get("sql", "")
   221→                        command = block.input.get("command", "")
   222→
   223→                        # Emit tool_call for ALL tool types
   224→                        tool_call_data: dict = {"id": block.id, "name": tool_name}
   225→                        if sql:
   226→                            tool_call_data["sql"] = sql
   227→                        if command:
   228→                            tool_call_data["command"] = command
   229→                        if not sql and not command:
   230→                            tool_call_data["input"] = block.input
   231→                        yield f"event: tool_call\ndata: {json.dumps(tool_call_data, default=str)}\n\n"
   232→
   233→                        # For SQL tools, execute query for structured results
   234→                        if sql:
   235→                            sql_result_ids.add(block.id)
   236→                            try:
   237→                                result = db.execute_query(sql)
   238→                                truncated = result["rows"][:100]
   239→                                yield f"event: tool_result\ndata: {json.dumps({'id': block.id, 'name': tool_name, 'sql': sql, 'columns': result['columns'], 'rows': truncated, 'rowCount': result['rowCount']}, default=str)}\n\n"
   240→                            except Exception as e:
   241→                                yield f"event: tool_result\ndata: {json.dumps({'id': block.id, 'name': tool_name, 'sql': sql, 'error': str(e)})}\n\n"
   242→
   243→            elif isinstance(msg, UserMessage):
   244→                # Capture tool results from the SDK for non-SQL tools
   245→                content = msg.content
   246→                if isinstance(content, list):
   247→                    for block in content:
   248→                        if isinstance(block, ToolResultBlock):
   249→                            if block.tool_use_id in sql_result_ids:
   250→                                continue
   251→                            output = _extract_tool_result_text(block.content)
   252→                            name = tool_names.get(block.tool_use_id, "")
   253→                            result_data: dict = {
   254→                                "id": block.tool_use_id,
   255→                                "name": name,
   256→                                "output": output,
   257→                            }
   258→                            if block.is_error:
   259→                                result_data["error"] = output
   260→                            yield f"event: tool_result\ndata: {json.dumps(result_data, default=str)}\n\n"
   261→
   262→            elif isinstance(msg, ResultMessage):
   263→                # Use the CLI's session_id so --resume can find it
   264→                actual_session_id = msg.session_id or actual_session_id
   265→                if msg.is_error and msg.result:
   266→                    yield f"event: error\ndata: {json.dumps({'message': msg.result})}\n\n"
   267→                yield f"event: done\ndata: {json.dumps({'session_id': actual_session_id})}\n\n"
   268→
   269→    except Exception as e:
   270→        error_msg = str(e)
   271→        if stderr_lines:
   272→            error_msg += f" | CLI stderr: {' '.join(stderr_lines[-5:])}"
   273→        logger.error("Agent error: %s", error_msg)
   274→        yield f"event: error\ndata: {json.dumps({'message': error_msg})}\n\n"
   275→    finally:
   276→        proxy_token_store.revoke_token(session_token)
   277→        # Update trace with the CLI's session_id so Langfuse session matches
   278→        if langfuse and observation_ctx:
   279→            try:
   280→                trace_session_id = langfuse_session_id or actual_session_id
   281→                langfuse.update_current_trace(
   282→                    session_id=trace_session_id,
   283→                    output={"session_id": actual_session_id},
   284→                )
   285→                if propagate_ctx:
   286→                    propagate_ctx.__exit__(None, None, None)
   287→                observation_ctx.__exit__(None, None, None)
   288→            except Exception as e:
   289→                logger.debug("Failed to finalize Langfuse trace: %s", e)
   290→            try:
   291→                langfuse.flush()
   292→            except Exception as e:
   293→                logger.debug("Failed to flush Langfuse: %s", e)
   294→
   295→        try:
   296→            await client.disconnect()
   297→        except Exception:
   298→            pass
   299→

1→import logging
     2→import os
     3→
     4→from app.config import LANGFUSE_ENABLED, LANGFUSE_BASE_URL
     5→
     6→logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
     7→
     8→_langfuse_client = None
     9→
    10→
    11→def _init_langfuse():
    12→    """Initialize Langfuse with OTel auto-instrumentation for Claude Agent SDK."""
    13→    global _langfuse_client
    14→    if not LANGFUSE_ENABLED:
    15→        logger.info("Langfuse not configured, tracing disabled")
    16→        return
    17→
    18→    # Set OTel env vars so langsmith routes traces through Langfuse.
    19→    # Must be set before any langsmith import to avoid LRU cache issues.
    20→    for key, val in {
    21→        "LANGSMITH_OTEL_ENABLED": "true",
    22→        "LANGSMITH_OTEL_ONLY": "true",
    23→        "LANGSMITH_TRACING": "true",
    24→    }.items():
    25→        os.environ.setdefault(key, val)
    26→
    27→    try:
    28→        from langfuse import get_client
    29→
    30→        _langfuse_client = get_client()
    31→
    32→        if _langfuse_client.auth_check():
    33→            logger.info("Langfuse connected successfully")
    34→        else:
    35→            logger.warning("Langfuse auth check failed, tracing disabled")
    36→            _langfuse_client = None
    37→            return
    38→
    39→        # Suppress harmless warnings from langsmith/OTel integration BEFORE
    40→        # creating Client (background thread starts during Client.__init__):
    41→        # 1. "Run compression is not enabled" — race condition: thread starts
    42→        #    before otel_exporter is assigned. Batch processing uses env vars.
    43→        # 2. "Invalid type dict for attribute" — langsmith sets usage_metadata
    44→        #    as a dict, but OTel only accepts primitive types.
    45→        logging.getLogger("langsmith.client").setLevel(logging.ERROR)
    46→        logging.getLogger("opentelemetry.attributes").setLevel(logging.ERROR)
    47→
    48→        # Pre-create the global LangSmith Client with otel_enabled=True
    49→        # so the background tracing thread knows to use OTel-only mode.
    50→        from langsmith.client import Client
    51→        from langsmith.run_trees import configure
    52→
    53→        configure(client=Client(otel_enabled=True))
    54→
    55→        # Enable auto-instrumentation for Claude Agent SDK
    56→        from langsmith.integrations.claude_agent_sdk import configure_claude_agent_sdk
    57→
    58→        if configure_claude_agent_sdk():
    59→            logger.info("Claude Agent SDK auto-instrumentation enabled")
    60→        else:
    61→            logger.warning(
    62→                "Failed to configure Claude Agent SDK auto-instrumentation"
    63→            )
    64→
    65→    except Exception as e:
    66→        logger.warning("Failed to initialize Langfuse: %s", e)
    67→        _langfuse_client = None
    68→
    69→
    70→def get_langfuse_client():
    71→    """Return the Langfuse client or None if not configured."""
    72→    return _langfuse_client
    73→
    74→
    75→def get_langfuse_dashboard_url() -> str | None:
    76→    """Return the Langfuse project traces URL or None."""
    77→    if _langfuse_client is None:
    78→        return None
    79→    try:
    80→        project_id = _langfuse_client._get_project_id()
    81→        if project_id:
    82→            return f"{LANGFUSE_BASE_URL}/project/{project_id}/traces"
    83→    except Exception as e:
    84→        logger.warning("Failed to get Langfuse project ID: %s", e)
    85→    return LANGFUSE_BASE_URL
    86→
    87→
    88→# Initialize on module import
    89→_init_langfuse()
    90→

1→import json
     2→from typing import Any
     3→from claude_agent_sdk import tool, create_sdk_mcp_server
     4→from app.database import Database
     5→
     6→MAX_RESULT_ROWS = 100
     7→
     8→
     9→def create_duckdb_server(db: Database):
    10→    @tool(
    11→        "execute_sql",
    12→        "Execute a SQL query against the DuckDB database. Use this to query loaded tables, "
    13→        "create views, or run any valid DuckDB SQL. Results are returned as JSON with columns, "
    14→        "rows, and rowCount.",
    15→        {"sql": str},
    16→    )
    17→    async def execute_sql(args: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    18→        sql = args["sql"]
    19→        try:
    20→            result = db.execute_query(sql)
    21→            truncated_rows = result["rows"][:MAX_RESULT_ROWS]
    22→            result_json = {
    23→                "status": "success",
    24→                "columns": result["columns"],
    25→                "rows": truncated_rows,
    26→                "rowCount": result["rowCount"],
    27→            }
    28→            content_text = json.dumps(result_json, default=str)
    29→            return {"content": [{"type": "text", "text": content_text}]}
    30→        except Exception as e:
    31→            error_json = {"status": "error", "error": str(e)}
    32→            return {
    33→                "content": [{"type": "text", "text": json.dumps(error_json)}],
    34→                "is_error": True,
    35→            }
    36→
    37→    return create_sdk_mcp_server(
    38→        name="duckdb",
    39→        version="1.0.0",
    40→        tools=[execute_sql],
    41→    )
    42→

1→# Credential Proxy Design
     2→
     3→**Date:** 2026-02-21
     4→**Status:** Approved
     5→
     6→## Problem
     7→
     8→The server runs `claude-agent-sdk` which spawns Claude Code CLI as a subprocess. The subprocess inherits the parent process environment, including `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`. A malicious user could craft a prompt to extract this token (e.g., `import os; print(os.environ)`), compromising the shared server account.
     9→
    10→## Solution
    11→
    12→A local reverse proxy runs inside the FastAPI app. Each chat session receives a short-lived UUID token. The Claude Code subprocess is given this UUID plus a `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` pointing to the local proxy. The proxy validates the UUID and swaps it for the real `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` before forwarding to `api.anthropic.com`.
    13→
    14→Even if a user extracts the UUID via prompt injection, it is useless outside `localhost` and expires when the chat session ends.
    15→
    16→## Architecture
    17→
    18→```
    19→[Server startup]
    20→  1. Read real token from CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN env var → store in memory
    21→
    22→[POST /api/chat]
    23→  2. Generate session UUID token
    24→  3. Register UUID → {expiry} in ActiveSessionTokens (TTL = chat session)
    25→  4. Pass to ClaudeAgentOptions(
    26→       env={
    27→         "CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN": "<session-uuid>",
    28→         "ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL": "http://127.0.0.1:10000/anthropic",
    29→       }
    30→     )
    31→  5. Claude Code subprocess sends Bearer <session-uuid> to local proxy
    32→
    33→[/anthropic/{path:path}]
    34→  6. Extract Bearer token from Authorization header
    35→  7. Validate it's a registered, non-expired session UUID
    36→  8. Replace Authorization → "Bearer <real CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN>"
    37→  9. Forward full request + body to https://api.anthropic.com/{path}
    38→ 10. Stream response back to Claude Code subprocess
    39→
    40→[SSE done/error event in agent.py]
    41→ 11. Revoke session UUID from ActiveSessionTokens
    42→```
    43→
    44→## Components
    45→
    46→| File | Change |
    47→|---|---|
    48→| `backend/app/proxy.py` | New — `ProxyTokenStore` + `/anthropic/{path}` FastAPI router |
    49→| `backend/app/agent.py` | Inject `env=` in `ClaudeAgentOptions`; accept token arg; revoke on done/error |
    50→| `backend/app/main.py` | Include proxy router |
    51→| `backend/app/config.py` | Read `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` from env |
    52→
    53→## Key Details
    54→
    55→### Env injection
    56→
    57→`subprocess_cli.py` builds the subprocess env as:
    58→```python
    59→process_env = {**os.environ, **options.env, ...}
    60→```
    61→`options.env` overrides win, so setting `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` in `options.env` prevents the subprocess from seeing the real token in `os.environ`.
    62→
    63→### Token store
    64→
    65→In-memory dict: `{uuid: expiry_datetime}`. Tokens are created at chat start and deleted on `done`/`error` SSE events. No persistence needed — tokens are ephemeral.
    66→
    67→### Proxy forwarding
    68→
    69→Uses `httpx.AsyncClient` to forward the full request (method, headers, body) to `https://api.anthropic.com`, streaming the response back. The only header modification is replacing `Authorization`.
    70→
    71→### Security properties
    72→
    73→- Subprocess never sees real `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`
    74→- UUID token is useless outside `localhost`
    75→- Token expires at session end (revoked explicitly, not just by TTL)
    76→- No OAuth refresh logic needed — proxy forwards the long-lived token as-is
    77→
    78→## Out of Scope
    79→
    80→- Per-user OAuth (all users share one server account)
    81→- Rate limiting per session (separate concern)
    82→- Persistent token storage
    83→

    86→import uuid
    87→from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
    88→
    89→from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Request
    90→from fastapi.responses import StreamingResponse
    91→import httpx

    98→_SKIP_RESPONSE_HEADERS = {"transfer-encoding", "content-encoding", "connection"}
    99→
   100→
   101→class ProxyTokenStore:
   102→    def __init__(self, ttl_seconds: int = 600):
   103→        self._ttl = ttl_seconds
   104→        self._tokens: dict[str, datetime] = {}
   105→
   106→    def create_token(self) -> str:
   107→        token = str(uuid.uuid4())
   108→        self._tokens[token] = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(seconds=self._ttl)
   109→        return token
   110→
   111→    def validate_token(self, token: str) -> bool:
   112→        expiry = self._tokens.get(token)
   113→        if expiry is None:
   114→            return False
   115→        if datetime.now(timezone.utc) > expiry:
   116→            self._tokens.pop(token, None)
   117→            return False
   118→        return True
   119→
   120→    def revoke_token(self, token: str) -> None:
   121→        self._tokens.pop(token, None)

   129→@router.api_route("/{path:path}", methods=["GET", "POST", "PUT", "DELETE", "PATCH"])
   130→async def proxy_anthropic(path: str, request: Request):
   131→    auth_header = request.headers.get("authorization", "")
   132→    if not auth_header.startswith("Bearer "):
   133→        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Missing Bearer token")
   134→
   135→    session_token = auth_header[7:]
   136→    if not proxy_token_store.validate_token(session_token):
   137→        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid or expired session token")
   138→
   139→    headers = {
   140→        k: v for k, v in request.headers.items()
   141→        if k.lower() not in _SKIP_REQUEST_HEADERS
   142→    }
   143→    headers["authorization"] = f"Bearer {CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN}"
   144→
   145→    body = await request.body()
   146→
   147→    client = httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=httpx.Timeout(300.0))
   148→    try:
   149→        upstream_req = client.build_request(
   150→            method=request.method,
   151→            url=f"{ANTHROPIC_UPSTREAM}/{path}",
   152→            headers=headers,
   153→            content=body,
   154→            params=dict(request.query_params),
   155→        )
   156→        upstream_resp = await client.send(upstream_req, stream=True)
   157→
   158→        response_headers = {
   159→            k: v for k, v in upstream_resp.headers.items()
   160→            if k.lower() not in _SKIP_RESPONSE_HEADERS
   161→        }
   162→
   163→        async def body_generator():

   166→                    yield chunk
   167→            finally:
   168→                await upstream_resp.aclose()
   169→                await client.aclose()
   170→
   171→        return StreamingResponse(
   172→            body_generator(),
   173→            status_code=upstream_resp.status_code,
   174→            headers=response_headers,
   175→        )
   176→    except Exception:

   178→        raise

1→import csv
     2→import duckdb
     3→import os
     4→import re
     5→import tempfile
     6→from typing import Any
     7→
     8→SUPPORTED_EXTENSIONS = {".csv", ".json", ".parquet", ".xlsx"}
     9→
    10→
    11→class Database:
    12→    def __init__(self):
    13→        self.conn = duckdb.connect(":memory:")
    14→
    15→    def execute_query(self, sql: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    16→        """Execute a SQL query and return results as dict with columns, rows, rowCount."""
    17→        result = self.conn.execute(sql)
    18→        if result is None:
    19→            return {"columns": [], "rows": [], "rowCount": 0}
    20→        columns = [desc[0] for desc in result.description] if result.description else []
    21→        rows = [dict(zip(columns, row)) for row in result.fetchall()] if columns else []
    22→        return {"columns": columns, "rows": rows, "rowCount": len(rows)}
    23→
    24→    def load_csv(self, file_bytes: bytes, filename: str, table_name: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    25→        """Load a CSV file into a DuckDB table. Returns table info."""
    26→        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".csv", delete=False) as tmp:
    27→            tmp.write(file_bytes)
    28→            tmp_path = tmp.name
    29→        try:
    30→            self.conn.execute(
    31→                f'CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "{table_name}" AS SELECT * FROM read_csv_auto(\'{tmp_path}\')'
    32→            )
    33→        finally:
    34→            os.unlink(tmp_path)
    35→        return self.get_table_info(table_name)
    36→
    37→    def load_json(self, file_bytes: bytes, filename: str, table_name: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    38→        """Load a JSON file (array of objects) into a DuckDB table. Returns table info."""
    39→        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".json", delete=False) as tmp:
    40→            tmp.write(file_bytes)
    41→            tmp_path = tmp.name
    42→        try:
    43→            self.conn.execute(
    44→                f'CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "{table_name}" AS SELECT * FROM read_json_auto(\'{tmp_path}\')'
    45→            )
    46→        finally:
    47→            os.unlink(tmp_path)
    48→        return self.get_table_info(table_name)
    49→
    50→    def load_parquet(self, file_bytes: bytes, filename: str, table_name: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    51→        """Load a Parquet file into a DuckDB table. Returns table info."""
    52→        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".parquet", delete=False) as tmp:
    53→            tmp.write(file_bytes)
    54→            tmp_path = tmp.name
    55→        try:
    56→            self.conn.execute(
    57→                f'CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "{table_name}" AS SELECT * FROM read_parquet(\'{tmp_path}\')'
    58→            )
    59→        finally:
    60→            os.unlink(tmp_path)
    61→        return self.get_table_info(table_name)
    62→
    63→    def load_excel(self, file_bytes: bytes, filename: str, base_table_name: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    64→        """Load an Excel file into DuckDB tables (one per sheet). Returns list of table infos."""
    65→        import openpyxl
    66→
    67→        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".xlsx", delete=False) as tmp:
    68→            tmp.write(file_bytes)
    69→            tmp_path = tmp.name
    70→        try:
    71→            wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(tmp_path, read_only=True, data_only=True)
    72→            sheet_names = wb.sheetnames
    73→            results = []
    74→            for sheet_name in sheet_names:
    75→                ws = wb[sheet_name]
    76→                rows = list(ws.iter_rows(values_only=True))
    77→                if not rows:
    78→                    continue
    79→                # Sanitize sheet name for table name
    80→                sanitized_sheet = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9_]", "_", sheet_name.lower())
    81→                sanitized_sheet = re.sub(r"_+", "_", sanitized_sheet).strip("_")
    82→                table_name = f"{base_table_name}_{sanitized_sheet}" if len(sheet_names) > 1 else base_table_name
    83→                # Write sheet data to temp CSV
    84→                with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode="w", suffix=".csv", delete=False, newline="") as csv_tmp:
    85→                    writer = csv.writer(csv_tmp)
    86→                    for row in rows:
    87→                        writer.writerow(row)
    88→                    csv_tmp_path = csv_tmp.name
    89→                try:
    90→                    self.conn.execute(
    91→                        f'CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "{table_name}" AS SELECT * FROM read_csv_auto(\'{csv_tmp_path}\')'
    92→                    )
    93→                    results.append(self.get_table_info(table_name))
    94→                finally:
    95→                    os.unlink(csv_tmp_path)
    96→            wb.close()
    97→            if not results:
    98→                raise ValueError("Excel file contains no data")
    99→            return results
   100→        finally:
   101→            os.unlink(tmp_path)
   102→
   103→    def load_file(self, file_bytes: bytes, filename: str, table_name: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
   104→        """Dispatch file loading based on extension. Returns list of table infos."""
   105→        ext = os.path.splitext(filename)[1].lower()
   106→        if ext == ".csv":
   107→            return [self.load_csv(file_bytes, filename, table_name)]
   108→        elif ext == ".json":
   109→            return [self.load_json(file_bytes, filename, table_name)]
   110→        elif ext == ".parquet":
   111→            return [self.load_parquet(file_bytes, filename, table_name)]
   112→        elif ext == ".xlsx":
   113→            return self.load_excel(file_bytes, filename, table_name)
   114→        else:
   115→            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported file format: {ext}")
   116→
   117→    def get_table_info(self, table_name: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
   118→        """Get info about a specific table."""
   119→        cols_result = self.conn.execute(f'DESCRIBE "{table_name}"')
   120→        columns = [
   121→            {"name": row[0], "type": row[1]}
   122→            for row in cols_result.fetchall()
   123→        ]
   124→        count_result = self.conn.execute(f'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "{table_name}"')
   125→        row_count = count_result.fetchone()[0]
   126→        return {"name": table_name, "columns": columns, "rowCount": row_count}
   127→
   128→    def list_tables(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
   129→        """List all tables with their schema info."""
   130→        tables_result = self.conn.execute("SHOW TABLES")
   131→        table_names = [row[0] for row in tables_result.fetchall()]
   132→        return [self.get_table_info(name) for name in table_names]
   133→
   134→    def drop_table(self, table_name: str) -> None:
   135→        """Drop a table."""
   136→        self.conn.execute(f'DROP TABLE IF EXISTS "{table_name}"')
   137→
   138→    def load_sample_data(self, csv_path: str, table_name: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
   139→        """Load sample CSV from a file path."""
   140→        self.conn.execute(
   141→            f'CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "{table_name}" AS SELECT * FROM read_csv_auto(\'{csv_path}\')'
   142→        )
   143→        return self.get_table_info(table_name)

1→import logging
     2→from dataclasses import dataclass, field
     3→from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
     4→
     5→from app.database import Database
     6→
     7→logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
     8→
     9→
    10→@dataclass
    11→class SessionEntry:
    12→    db: Database
    13→    last_seen_at: datetime = field(default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc))
    14→
    15→
    16→class SessionManager:
    17→    def __init__(self) -> None:
    18→        self._sessions: dict[str, SessionEntry] = {}
    19→
    20→    def get_or_create(self, session_id: str) -> Database:
    21→        if session_id not in self._sessions:
    22→            logger.info("Creating new session: %s", session_id)
    23→            self._sessions[session_id] = SessionEntry(db=Database())
    24→        else:
    25→            self._sessions[session_id].last_seen_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    26→        return self._sessions[session_id].db
    27→
    28→    def touch(self, session_id: str) -> bool:
    29→        if session_id not in self._sessions:
    30→            return False
    31→        self._sessions[session_id].last_seen_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    32→        return True
    33→
    34→    def destroy(self, session_id: str) -> None:
    35→        if session_id not in self._sessions:
    36→            return
    37→        try:
    38→            self._sessions[session_id].db.conn.close()
    39→        except Exception:
    40→            pass
    41→        del self._sessions[session_id]
    42→        logger.info("Destroyed session: %s", session_id)
    43→
    44→    def cleanup_stale(self, ttl_seconds: int = 300) -> int:
    45→        cutoff = datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(seconds=ttl_seconds)
    46→        stale = [
    47→            sid for sid, entry in self._sessions.items()
    48→            if entry.last_seen_at < cutoff
    49→        ]
    50→        for sid in stale:
    51→            self.destroy(sid)
    52→        return len(stale)
    53→
    54→
    55→session_manager = SessionManager()
    56→

Excellent! Now I have a complete understanding of the system. Let me create a comprehensive summary document:

## Credential Proxy & Langfuse Integration - Complete System Overview

Based on my exploration of the codebase, here's a comprehensive understanding of how the credential proxy and Langfuse observability work in the DuckDB Data Agent:

---

## 1. CREDENTIAL PROXY IMPLEMENTATION

### Architecture Overview

The credential proxy system prevents the Claude Code subprocess from accessing the real Anthropic API key through prompt injection attacks. Instead, it issues short-lived UUID tokens that are scoped to individual chat sessions.

```
User Browser
    ↓
  FastAPI Backend (/api/chat endpoint)
    ↓
Creates short-lived UUID token (10 min TTL)
    ↓
Spawns Claude Code subprocess with:
  - ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=<UUID token>
  - ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:10000/anthropic
    ↓
Claude Code subprocess makes requests to /anthropic/{path}
    ↓
Proxy validates UUID token
    ↓
Swaps UUID for real ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
    ↓
Forwards request to https://api.anthropic.com
    ↓
Streams response back to subprocess
```

### Key Files

#### `/Users/cyyeh/Desktop/duckdb-data-agent/backend/app/proxy.py` (125 lines)
Core proxy implementation with two main components:

**ProxyTokenStore class:**
- `create_token()`: Generates a random UUID v4 with 10-minute TTL (600 seconds)
- `validate_token(token)`: Checks if token exists and hasn't expired
- `revoke_token(token)`: Immediately invalidates a token (called in finally block)
- `cleanup_expired()`: Background task that removes expired tokens (runs every 60s)
- Internal storage: `_tokens: dict[str, datetime]` - maps UUID to expiry datetime

**ProxyTokenStore instance:** `proxy_token_store` is a module-level singleton

**Proxy Route Handler:** `proxy_anthropic(path: str, request: Request)`
- Accepts all HTTP methods: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH
- Validates token from `x-api-key` header (Claude Code default) or `Authorization: Bearer` header
- Returns 401 if token is invalid/expired/missing
- Forwards request to `https://api.anthropic.com/{path}` with real API key
- Streams response back with proper async cleanup
- Intentionally does NOT forward query params (Claude Code adds internal params that Anthropic rejects)
- Strips headers: host, content-length, transfer-encoding, connection, x-api-key
- Injects: x-api-key (real API key), anthropic-version (2023-06-01), anthropic-beta (preserved for SDK compatibility)
- Uses fresh httpx.AsyncClient per request to prevent SSL MAC errors from incomplete streams

#### `/Users/cyyeh/Desktop/duckdb-data-agent/backend/app/agent.py` (299 lines)
Integration of proxy tokens into the agent lifecycle:

**Token Creation (line 124):**
```python
session_token = proxy_token_store.create_token()
```

**Token Injection into subprocess (lines 134-137):**
```python
env={
    "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY": session_token,
    "ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL": f"{PROXY_BASE_URL}/anthropic",
}
```

**Token Revocation in finally block (line 276):**
```python
finally:
    proxy_token_store.revoke_token(session_token)
```

The token is revoked immediately when:
- Agent completes successfully
- Agent encounters an error
- Session is terminated

This ensures tokens never linger beyond the session lifecycle.

#### `/Users/cyyeh/Desktop/duckdb-data-agent/backend/app/config.py` (24 lines)
Configuration variables:
```python
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = os.getenv("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY", "")  # Real API key
PROXY_BASE_URL = os.getenv("PROXY_BASE_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:10000")  # Proxy URL
ANTHROPIC_MODEL = os.getenv("ANTHROPIC_MODEL", "claude-opus-4-6")
```

#### `/Users/cyyeh/Desktop/duckdb-data-agent/backend/app/main.py` (74 lines)
FastAPI app setup:

**Proxy router registration (line 53):**
```python
app.include_router(proxy_module.router)
```

**Background cleanup loop (lines 19-27):**
- Runs every 60 seconds
- Cleans up stale DuckDB sessions (5-minute TTL)
- Cleans up expired proxy tokens (TTL overflow safety net)
- Logs count of removed items for monitoring

---

## 2. LANGFUSE OBSERVABILITY INTEGRATION

### Purpose
Optional observability layer for monitoring agent interactions, tool calls, and LLM performance.

### Key Files

#### `/Users/cyyeh/Desktop/duckdb-data-agent/backend/app/tracing.py` (90 lines)
Complete Langfuse initialization and management:

**Initialization (_init_langfuse, lines 11-67):**
1. Checks if Langfuse is configured (requires both LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY and LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY)
2. Sets up OpenTelemetry environment variables for langsmith integration
3. Initializes Langfuse client via `get_client()`
4. Performs auth_check() to validate credentials
5. Pre-configures LangSmith Client with OTel enabled
6. Enables Claude Agent SDK auto-instrumentation via `configure_claude_agent_sdk()`
7. Suppresses harmless OTel warnings (race conditions, attribute type mismatches)
8. Returns None if not configured (zero overhead)

**Client accessors:**
- `get_langfuse_client()`: Returns the Langfuse client or None
- `get_langfuse_dashboard_url()`: Returns the project traces URL for frontend link

**Environment variables checked:**
```
LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY=pk-lf-...
LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY=sk-lf-...
LANGFUSE_BASE_URL=https://cloud.langfuse.com (optional, defaults to cloud)
```

#### `/Users/cyyeh/Desktop/duckdb-data-agent/backend/app/agent.py` (lines 149-293)
Langfuse integration within agent loop:

**Trace initialization (lines 151-171):**
```python
langfuse = get_langfuse_client()
if langfuse:
    observation_ctx = langfuse.start_as_current_observation(
        name="agent-chat",
        input={"message": message[:500], "conversation_history": ...},
        metadata={"model": ANTHROPIC_MODEL},
    )
```

**Session propagation (lines 167-171):**
Uses `propagate_attributes(session_id=...)` to maintain consistent session ID across child spans

**Trace finalization (lines 277-293):**
- Updates trace with final session_id from Claude Code CLI
- Exits observation context
- Flushes buffered spans to Langfuse cloud
- Handles errors gracefully without crashing the agent

#### `/Users/cyyeh/Desktop/duckdb-data-agent/backend/app/routes/langfuse_status.py` (14 lines)
Frontend endpoint to check Langfuse status:

**GET /api/langfuse/status:**
```json
{
  "enabled": true/false,
  "dashboardUrl": "https://cloud.langfuse.com/project/{project_id}/traces"
}
```

Used by frontend to conditionally show "Langfuse Traces" button in agent panel header.

---

## 3. REQUEST FLOW - COMPLETE JOURNEY

### User Sends Chat Message

**Frontend (React):**
1. User types message and submits via `/api/chat` POST with body:
```json
{
  "message": "What is the average price?",
  "session_id": "<agent_session_id_or_null>",
  "langfuse_session_id": "<stable_trace_id>",
  "conversation_history": [...]
}
```
2. Includes `X-Session-ID` header (per-user DuckDB session)
3. EventSource opens SSE connection

**Backend Routes (/api/chat endpoint):**

    26→class ProxyTokenStore:

    29→        self._tokens: dict[str, datetime] = {}

    31→    def create_token(self) -> str:
    32→        token = str(uuid.uuid4())
    33→        self._tokens[token] = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(seconds=self._ttl)
    34→        return token
    35→
    36→    def validate_token(self, token: str) -> bool:
    37→        # Tokens are intentionally multi-use: Claude Code makes many API calls
    38→        # per session, all protected by the same UUID. The token is valid for
    39→        # the session TTL (600s safety net) but is explicitly revoked by
    40→        # proxy_token_store.revoke_token() in agent.py's finally block when
    41→        # the Claude Code subprocess exits. Do not make single-use.
    42→        expiry = self._tokens.get(token)
    43→        if expiry is None:
    44→            return False
    45→        if datetime.now(timezone.utc) > expiry:
    46→            self._tokens.pop(token, None)
    47→            return False
    48→        return True
    49→
    50→    def revoke_token(self, token: str) -> None:
    51→        self._tokens.pop(token, None)

    53→    def cleanup_expired(self) -> int:

import logging
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Request
from fastapi.responses import StreamingResponse
import httpx

from app.config import ANTHROPIC_API_KEY

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

ANTHROPIC_UPSTREAM = "https://api.anthropic.com"

_SKIP_REQUEST_HEADERS = {
    "host", "content-length", "transfer-encoding", "connection",
    "x-api-key",         # client must not override billing identity
    "anthropic-version", # proxy controls API version
    # anthropic-beta is intentionally NOT blocked: Claude Code sends beta body
    # fields (e.g. context_management) alongside the matching beta header, and
    # Anthropic rejects those fields as "extra inputs" if the header is absent.
}
_SKIP_RESPONSE_HEADERS = {"transfer-encoding", "content-encoding", "connection"}


class ProxyTokenStore:
    def __init__(self, ttl_seconds: int = 600):
        self._ttl = ttl_seconds
        self._tokens: dict[str, datetime] = {}

    def create_token(self) -> str:
        token = str(uuid.uuid4())
        self._tokens[token] = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(seconds=self._ttl)
        return token

    def validate_token(self, token: str) -> bool:
        # Tokens are intentionally multi-use: Claude Code makes many API calls
        # per session, all protected by the same UUID. The token is valid for
        # the session TTL (600s safety net) but is explicitly revoked by
        # proxy_token_store.revoke_token() in agent.py's finally block when
        # the Claude Code subprocess exits. Do not make single-use.
        expiry = self._tokens.get(token)
        if expiry is None:
            return False
        if datetime.now(timezone.utc) > expiry:
            self._tokens.pop(token, None)
            return False
        return True

    def revoke_token(self, token: str) -> None:
        self._tokens.pop(token, None)

    def cleanup_expired(self) -> int:
        now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        expired = [t for t, exp in self._tokens.items() if now > exp]
        for t in expired:
            del self._tokens[t]
        return len(expired)


proxy_token_store = ProxyTokenStore()

router = APIRouter(prefix="/anthropic")


@router.api_route("/{path:path}", methods=["GET", "POST", "PUT", "DELETE", "PATCH"])
async def proxy_anthropic(path: str, request: Request):
    # Claude Code CLI sends the API key as x-api-key (Anthropic SDK default).
    # Fall back to Authorization: Bearer for other clients.
    session_token = (
        request.headers.get("x-api-key")
        or request.headers.get("authorization", "")[len("Bearer "):]
        or None
    )
    if not session_token or not proxy_token_store.validate_token(session_token):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid or expired session token")

    headers = {
        k: v for k, v in request.headers.items()
        if k.lower() not in _SKIP_REQUEST_HEADERS
    }
    headers["x-api-key"] = ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
    headers["anthropic-version"] = "2023-06-01"

    body = await request.body()

    # Use a fresh client per request: streaming responses that are cut short
    # (e.g. client disconnects) leave connections in a partial read state, and
    # reusing a shared SSL context across those connections causes
    # SSLV3_ALERT_BAD_RECORD_MAC / record layer failure errors.
    # Query params are intentionally NOT forwarded — Claude Code appends
    # internal params (e.g. ?beta=true) that Anthropic rejects as "extra inputs".
    client = httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=httpx.Timeout(300.0))
    try:
        upstream_req = client.build_request(
            method=request.method,
            url=f"{ANTHROPIC_UPSTREAM}/{path}",
            headers=headers,
            content=body,
        )
        upstream_resp = await client.send(upstream_req, stream=True)

        response_headers = {
            k: v for k, v in upstream_resp.headers.items()
            if k.lower() not in _SKIP_RESPONSE_HEADERS
        }

        async def body_generator():
            try:
                async for chunk in upstream_resp.aiter_bytes():
                    yield chunk
            finally:
                await upstream_resp.aclose()
                await client.aclose()

        return StreamingResponse(
            body_generator(),
            status_code=upstream_resp.status_code,
            headers=response_headers,
        )
    except Exception:
        await client.aclose()
        logger.exception("Proxy request to upstream failed: %s %s", request.method, path)
        raise

import logging
import os

from app.config import LANGFUSE_ENABLED, LANGFUSE_BASE_URL

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

_langfuse_client = None


def _init_langfuse():
    """Initialize Langfuse with OTel auto-instrumentation for Claude Agent SDK."""
    global _langfuse_client
    if not LANGFUSE_ENABLED:
        logger.info("Langfuse not configured, tracing disabled")
        return

    # Set OTel env vars so langsmith routes traces through Langfuse.
    # Must be set before any langsmith import to avoid LRU cache issues.
    for key, val in {
        "LANGSMITH_OTEL_ENABLED": "true",
        "LANGSMITH_OTEL_ONLY": "true",
        "LANGSMITH_TRACING": "true",
    }.items():
        os.environ.setdefault(key, val)

    try:
        from langfuse import get_client

        _langfuse_client = get_client()

        if _langfuse_client.auth_check():
            logger.info("Langfuse connected successfully")
        else:
            logger.warning("Langfuse auth check failed, tracing disabled")
            _langfuse_client = None
            return

        # Suppress harmless warnings from langsmith/OTel integration BEFORE
        # creating Client (background thread starts during Client.__init__):
        # 1. "Run compression is not enabled" — race condition: thread starts
        #    before otel_exporter is assigned. Batch processing uses env vars.
        # 2. "Invalid type dict for attribute" — langsmith sets usage_metadata
        #    as a dict, but OTel only accepts primitive types.
        logging.getLogger("langsmith.client").setLevel(logging.ERROR)
        logging.getLogger("opentelemetry.attributes").setLevel(logging.ERROR)

        # Pre-create the global LangSmith Client with otel_enabled=True
        # so the background tracing thread knows to use OTel-only mode.
        from langsmith.client import Client
        from langsmith.run_trees import configure

        configure(client=Client(otel_enabled=True))

        # Enable auto-instrumentation for Claude Agent SDK
        from langsmith.integrations.claude_agent_sdk import configure_claude_agent_sdk

        if configure_claude_agent_sdk():
            logger.info("Claude Agent SDK auto-instrumentation enabled")
        else:
            logger.warning(
                "Failed to configure Claude Agent SDK auto-instrumentation"
            )

    except Exception as e:
        logger.warning("Failed to initialize Langfuse: %s", e)
        _langfuse_client = None


def get_langfuse_client():
    """Return the Langfuse client or None if not configured."""
    return _langfuse_client


def get_langfuse_dashboard_url() -> str | None:
    """Return the Langfuse project traces URL or None."""
    if _langfuse_client is None:
        return None
    try:
        project_id = _langfuse_client._get_project_id()
        if project_id:
            return f"{LANGFUSE_BASE_URL}/project/{project_id}/traces"
    except Exception as e:
        logger.warning("Failed to get Langfuse project ID: %s", e)
    return LANGFUSE_BASE_URL


# Initialize on module import
_init_langfuse()

   203→                    block = event.get("content_block", {})
   204→                    block_type = block.get("type")
   205→                    if block_type == "thinking":
   206→                        has_thinking = True
   207→                    elif block_type == "text":
   208→                        if has_thinking:
   209→                            yield f"event: thinking_done\ndata: {json.dumps({})}\n\n"
   210→                    elif block_type == "tool_use":
   211→                        has_thinking = False
   212→                        has_tool_calls = True
   213→
   214→            elif isinstance(msg, AssistantMessage):
   215→                for block in msg.content:
   216→                    if isinstance(block, ToolUseBlock):
   217→                        has_tool_calls = True
   218→                        tool_name = getattr(block, "name", "") or ""
   219→                        tool_names[block.id] = tool_name
   220→                        sql = block.input.get("sql", "")
   221→                        command = block.input.get("command", "")
   222→
   223→                        # Emit tool_call for ALL tool types
   224→                        tool_call_data: dict = {"id": block.id, "name": tool_name}
   225→                        if sql:
   226→                            tool_call_data["sql"] = sql
   227→                        if command:
   228→                            tool_call_data["command"] = command
   229→                        if not sql and not command:
   230→                            tool_call_data["input"] = block.input
   231→                        yield f"event: tool_call\ndata: {json.dumps(tool_call_data, default=str)}\n\n"
   232→
   233→                        # For SQL tools, execute query for structured results
   234→                        if sql:
   235→                            sql_result_ids.add(block.id)
   236→                            try:
   237→                                result = db.execute_query(sql)
   238→                                truncated = result["rows"][:100]
   239→                                yield f"event: tool_result\ndata: {json.dumps({'id': block.id, 'name': tool_name, 'sql': sql, 'columns': result['columns'], 'rows': truncated, 'rowCount': result['rowCount']}, default=str)}\n\n"
   240→                            except Exception as e:
   241→                                yield f"event: tool_result\ndata: {json.dumps({'id': block.id, 'name': tool_name, 'sql': sql, 'error': str(e)})}\n\n"
   242→
   243→            elif isinstance(msg, UserMessage):
   244→                # Capture tool results from the SDK for non-SQL tools
   245→                content = msg.content

   252→                            name = tool_names.get(block.tool_use_id, "")

   256→                                "output": output,
   257→                            }
   258→                            if block.is_error:
   259→                                result_data["error"] = output
   260→                            yield f"event: tool_result\ndata: {json.dumps(result_data, default=str)}\n\n"
   261→
   262→            elif isinstance(msg, ResultMessage):
   263→                # Use the CLI's session_id so --resume can find it
   264→                actual_session_id = msg.session_id or actual_session_id

   266→                    yield f"event: error\ndata: {json.dumps({'message': msg.result})}\n\n"
   267→                yield f"event: done\ndata: {json.dumps({'session_id': actual_session_id})}\n\n"
   268→
   269→    except Exception as e:

   271→        if stderr_lines:

   273→        logger.error("Agent error: %s", error_msg)

   275→    finally:

   108→This module manages a single in-memory DuckDB connection. It handles CSV uploads, table listing, and SQL execution.
   109→
   110→```python
   111→import duckdb
   112→import os
   113→import tempfile
   114→from typing import Any
   115→
   116→
   117→class Database:
   118→    def __init__(self):
   119→        self.conn = duckdb.connect(":memory:")
   120→
   121→    def execute_query(self, sql: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
   122→        """Execute a SQL query and return results as dict with columns, rows, rowCount."""
   123→        result = self.conn.execute(sql)
   124→        columns = [desc[0] for desc in result.description] if result.description else []
   125→        rows = [dict(zip(columns, row)) for row in result.fetchall()] if columns else []
   126→        return {"columns": columns, "rows": rows, "rowCount": len(rows)}
   127→
   128→    def load_csv(self, file_bytes: bytes, filename: str, table_name: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
   129→        """Load a CSV file into a DuckDB table. Returns table info."""
   130→        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".csv", delete=False) as tmp:
   131→            tmp.write(file_bytes)
   132→            tmp_path = tmp.name
   133→        try:
   134→            self.conn.execute(
   135→                f'CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "{table_name}" AS SELECT * FROM read_csv_auto(\'{tmp_path}\')'
   136→            )
   137→        finally:
   138→            os.unlink(tmp_path)
   139→        return self.get_table_info(table_name)
   140→
   141→    def get_table_info(self, table_name: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
   142→        """Get info about a specific table."""
   143→        cols_result = self.conn.execute(f'DESCRIBE "{table_name}"')
   144→        columns = [
   145→            {"name": row[0], "type": row[1]}
   146→            for row in cols_result.fetchall()
   147→        ]
   148→        count_result = self.conn.execute(f'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "{table_name}"')
   149→        row_count = count_result.fetchone()[0]
   150→        return {"name": table_name, "columns": columns, "rowCount": row_count}
   151→
   152→    def list_tables(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
   153→        """List all tables with their schema info."""
   154→        tables_result = self.conn.execute("SHOW TABLES")
   155→        table_names = [row[0] for row in tables_result.fetchall()]
   156→        return [self.get_table_info(name) for name in table_names]
   157→

   409→from claude_agent_sdk import (

   419→from app.tools import create_duckdb_server

   423→def build_system_prompt() -> str:

   425→    prompt = """You are a helpful data analyst assistant working with a DuckDB database.

   428→Guidelines:

   431→- Explain your findings in plain language after getting results
   432→- If a query fails, try to fix it and retry
   433→- Use double quotes for table and column names that might conflict with reserved words
   434→"""
   435→    if not tables:
   436→        prompt += "\nNo tables are currently loaded. Ask the user to upload a CSV file first."
   437→    else:
   438→        prompt += "\nCurrently loaded tables:\n"
   439→        for table in tables:

   441→            for col in table["columns"]:

   448→    duckdb_server = create_duckdb_server()
   449→
   450→    options = ClaudeAgentOptions(
   451→        system_prompt=build_system_prompt(),
   452→        mcp_servers={"duckdb": duckdb_server},
   453→        allowed_tools=["mcp__duckdb__execute_sql"],
   454→        permission_mode="bypassPermissions",
   455→        max_turns=20,
   456→        include_partial_messages=True,
   457→    )
   458→
   459→    client = ClaudeSDKClient(options=options)
   460→    actual_session_id = session_id
   461→

   463→        if session_id:
   464→            await client.connect()
   465→            await client.query(message, session_id=session_id)
   466→        else:
   467→            await client.connect(prompt=message)

   469→        current_text = ""
   470→        has_tool_calls = False
   471→        thinking_sent = False
   472→
   473→        async for msg in client.receive_messages():
